rules.standard:
# Keycorner: selected keyboard only; active local session access.
SUBSYSTEM=="input", KERNEL=="event*", ENV{ID_INPUT_KEYBOARD}=="1", KERNELS=="1-6", ATTRS{idVendor}=="3034", ATTRS{idProduct}=="5659", ATTRS{serial}=="vial:synthetic", TAG+="uaccess"
rules.vial:
# Keycorner: selected keyboard only; active local session access.
SUBSYSTEM=="hidraw", KERNEL=="hidraw*", KERNELS=="1-6", ATTRS{idVendor}=="3034", ATTRS{idProduct}=="5659", ATTRS{serial}=="vial:synthetic", TAG+="uaccess"

rendered_shortcuts:
-- Managed by Keycorner settings. Blank shortcuts are disabled.
-- Bindings are unavailable while the screen is locked.
o.bind("SUPER + CTRL + SHIFT + K", "Keycorner: show/resume or hide/pause", "omarchy-shell keycorner toggle")
o.bind("SUPER + CTRL + SHIFT + O", "Keycorner: toggle settings", "omarchy-shell keycorner toggleSettings")
o.bind("SUPER + CTRL + SHIFT + P", "Keycorner: pause/resume input", "omarchy-shell keycorner pause")
